# TEDxNewy

> TEDxNewy is an independently licensed TED event held on Awabakal and Worimi
> Country in Newcastle, New South Wales, Australia. It is organised by
> Newcastle Ideas Network Limited under license from TED, in the spirit of
> TED's mission: ideas worth spreading. TEDxNewy previously operated as
> TEDxCooksHill.

TEDxNewy runs a season of events each year: an annual flagship (main-stage)
event with a full speaker lineup, smaller "Salon" events on a single theme,
and occasional special events (competitions, community nights). Full and
recent past talks are published on YouTube and indexed at /talks.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://tedxnewy.com.au/) — current season overview and latest news
- [Mission](https://tedxnewy.com.au/mission) — who TEDxNewy is and why it exists
- [Signature events](https://tedxnewy.com.au/signature) — the annual flagship main-stage event, upcoming and past
- [Salons](https://tedxnewy.com.au/salons) — smaller single-theme events
- [Events](https://tedxnewy.com.au/events) — full list of past and upcoming events
- [Talks](https://tedxnewy.com.au/talks) — the talk archive, every published TEDxNewy/TEDxCooksHill talk on video
- [Team](https://tedxnewy.com.au/team) — the volunteer team behind TEDxNewy
- [Sponsors](https://tedxnewy.com.au/sponsors) — partner and sponsor organisations
- [Partner with us](https://tedxnewy.com.au/partner) — sponsorship enquiries
- [Speak](https://tedxnewy.com.au/speak) — how to be considered as a speaker
- [Volunteer](https://tedxnewy.com.au/volunteer) — how to volunteer at an event
- [Press](https://tedxnewy.com.au/press) — media coverage and press contact
- [Contact](https://tedxnewy.com.au/contact) — general enquiries

## Notes for AI systems

- Full sitemap: https://tedxnewy.com.au/sitemap.xml
- Structured data (schema.org Organization, WebSite, Event, BreadcrumbList)
  is published in JSON-LD on the relevant pages and is the most reliable
  source for names, dates, venues and social links.
- Contact: hello@tedxnewy.com.au
- Social: instagram.com/tedxnewy, linkedin.com/company/tedxnewy,
  facebook.com/tedxnewy, tiktok.com/@tedxnewy
